comment: Metric-view base for the TB liquidity-structures view (D13 record_type union, month-end grain from Apr-2023): record_type 'Structure member' = one row per liquidity structure x member account x month-end (from fact_liquidity_structure_monthly: structure type, header / member country, currency, member balance, interest saved, fee) and record_type 'Group' = one row per client group x month-end (from fact_deposit_balance_monthly: the group's total / CASA / TD deposits, the APAC countries it holds accounts in, whether it runs an active liquidity structure and the pooling-candidate flag: >= 3 APAC countries and no active structure). Measures never mix the two: member_* / interest / fee columns are 0 or null on Group rows and group_* columns are 0 or null on member rows. Balances are POINT-IN-TIME (one month-end; never sum across months).
